subject: Discovery follow-up: Scheduling demo & looping in security/procurement - FinPath
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@finpath.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finpath.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up + next steps (demo scheduling)

Hi Samir / Priya -

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through FinPath's current search-and-assist workflow and the three main priorities you called out: accuracy for financial Q&A, latency under heavy load, and data isolation for audit purposes. Good takeaway notes from our end:

- Primary use case: internal analyst assistant + customer-facing help center
- Peak concurrency: ~1200 reqs/min during close periods
- Data constraints: PCI-adjacent; need SOC2 evidence and support for customer-managed encryption keys

Next steps I recommend:
1) 45-60 min demo + technical deep dive with Rafael (SE) to cover architecture, latency numbers, and prefix caching/quantization options
2) Loop in your security and procurement folks so we can share SOC 2 artifacts and align on the mutual action plan
3) Share a short list of questions you want the demo to cover (model quality vs latency tradeoffs, SSO/KMS, retention)

Proposed times (PT):
- Thu Feb 12, 10:00-11:00am
- Thu Feb 12, 2:00-3:00pm
- Fri Feb 13, 9:00-10:00am

If those don't work, let me know a couple windows and I'll coordinate. Looping Rafael on this thread to propose an agenda and runbook. I'll also attach a short security overview and a draft mutual action plan for procurement to review.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood-security-overview.pdf, FinPath-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

From: Samir Khan <samir.k@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finpath.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 16:10:24 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up + next steps (demo scheduling)

Thanks Marissa - great summary. Both Priya and I are aligned on the priorities. Priya will be the primary procurement contact; I'll loop in our security lead after we lock a time.

The Thu Feb 12, 2:00-3:00pm slot works for me. Priya, is that okay on your side?

Also, could Rafael include a slide or two about how Redwood handles customer-managed keys and audit logs? That'll help our security folks get context before the meeting.

Cheers,
Samir
Head of Product, FinPath
samir.k@finpath.com

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samir Khan <samir.k@finpath.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 16:32:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up + next steps (demo scheduling)

2:00-3:00pm PT on Thu works for procurement. I'll forward this thread to our security lead (Aisha Rahman) and CFO for procurement sizing. Please send the invite once confirmed.

Thanks,
Priya
Procurement Manager, FinPath

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@finpath.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@finpath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up + next steps (demo scheduling)

Hi Samir / Priya -

Thanks for confirming - Rafael from Redwood SE team here (looping Monica from security). I'll put together a focused agenda:

Agenda (45 min):
- 0-5m: quick intros & agenda
- 5-20m: platform overview focused on latency/throughput tradeoffs (batching, KV cache)
- 20-35m: architecture deep dive: private deployment options, KMS/HSM integration, audit logs
- 35-45m: Q&A + next steps (PoC scope / mutual action plan)

Monica has attached a short security FAQ and the SOC2 summary to this thread for your security lead to review ahead of time. Also attaching the mutual action plan workbook.

Would you like me to include an optional 30-minute follow-up technical session with infra/ops if your security team requests deeper log/sample review?

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-security-overview.pdf, FinPath-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

From: Samir Khan <samir.k@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finpath.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@finpath.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up + next steps (demo scheduling)

Perfect - thanks everyone. I've added Aisha (security) on the cc. The 2:00-3:00pm PT slot is on our calendars; please send a calendar invite with the agenda. For the PoC, we'll want to capture expected throughput and a tentative timeline - I'll fill out the MAP worksheet and share prior to the meeting.

Aisha: quick note on what to expect from the session - Redwood will demo architecture and show SOC2 artifacts + options for KMS/HSM. Rafael and Monica will be able to drill into logs and retention policies as needed.

Thanks,
Samir
